patches.purpose: Make the six LP pivot statistic counters (dd_statBApivots, dd_statCCpivots, dd_statDS1pivots, dd_statDS2pivots, dd_statACpivots, dd_statBSpivots) and their generated ddf_ twins _Thread_local. cddlp.c adds to them at the end of every LP (lines 1068, 1372, 1552-1553, 1665, 3677; cddlp_f.c likewise), which is a C11 data race when two threads solve LPs at once. They are only read by cddlib's report writers, which this crate never calls, so results are unchanged. Every other process-wide object is written only by dd_set_global_constants, which the crate runs once (std::sync::Once) before any other call; upstream 0.94n already declares all function-local scratch buffers and the splitmix64 state _Thread_local.
patches.apply: cd vendor && patch -p1 --fuzz=0 < patches/0001-thread-local-pivot-counters.patch (applies to the pristine files listed in PROVENANCE.json and GENERATION_RECEIPT.json)
patches.recover_original: cd vendor && patch -R -p1 --fuzz=0 < patches/0001-thread-local-pivot-counters.patch; the four files then hash to original_sha256 below (checked 2026-10-15)
patches.generated_units: generated/cdd_f.h and generated/cddlib_f.c were regenerated from the patched lib-src with python3 -I -B generate_float_sources.py lib-src OUT; the other seven generated files came out byte-identical to GENERATION_RECEIPT.json
patches.c_only: _Thread_local is C11; cdd.h is no longer valid C++ (its extern "C" block), which does not matter because only C units include it
patches.verification: tsan/run.sh (2026-10-15): ThreadSanitizer on 8 threads computing hulls and solving LPs concurrently through shim/ucdd.c after one ucdd_init: pristine sources report 10 data races, all on the pivot counter updates (cddlp_f.c:1069, 1373, 1553, 1554; cddlp.c:3677); patched sources report none; both give correct results. tests/concurrency.rs runs 16 threads x 200 rounds through the Rust API without a lock and compares every result with a sequential run.
